system.description: You can use the Force Trance application of the Use the Force skill to recover Hit Points through Natural Healing. You can also receive Hit Points from the Vital Transfer Force Power. Whenever you receive Bonus Hit Points from any source, you gain additional Bonus Hit Points equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum +1).
